entities.summary: John Jerry is an American former professional football player who was a guard in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ole Miss Rebels and was selected by the Miami Dolphins in the third round of the 2010 NFL draft. He also played for the New York Giants and Cincinnati Bengals.
